item.title: Ukraine's leading postal service breaks into US market with UPS partnership
item.description: Customers will be able to send packages up to 30 kilograms to Ukraine via 6,000 UPS Store locations across the U.S., Nova Poshta said in a press release on Feb. 18.

item.title: Ukraine hits 6 Russian military targets, including S-300VM missile launcher, General Staff says
item.description: Ukraine carried out a series of successful overnight attacks on Feb. 17–18 against military facilities in Russia and Russian-occupied territories.

item.title: 'Difficult' talks in Geneva — Zelensky signals progress on ceasefire, political stalemate continues
item.description: "We agreed to continue and move forward," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

item.title: Ukraine reportedly strikes oil depot in Russia's Pskov Oblast, targets Belgorod with missiles, leaving blackouts
item.description: Ukraine reportedly struck an oil depot in Russia's Pskov Oblast and launched missiles at the Russian city of Belgorod, causing power outages in parts of the city, Telegram news channels and local authorities reported overnight Feb. 18-19.

item.title: Zelensky says Ukraine won’t withdraw from Donbas, 'won’t lose dignity' as peace talks stall on territory
item.description: "Thousands, dozens of thousands of Ukrainians have been killed on this direction, defending this part of Ukraine," Zelensky said in an interview with British broadcaster Piers Morgan. "We have to understand that Donbas is a part of our independence."
